Emil Victor Langlet was a Swedish architect. He is most commonly associated with his design for the 
Norwegian Parliament Building in Oslo, Norway. Emil Victor Langlet was a architects & engineers from Borås parish (1824-02-26, Borås parish–1898-03-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
